purpose: Teach: オルガン/学童/祭壇/観覧/顕微鏡/プレビュー/ガーナ/売れ行き

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、音楽の授業で、本気で、絶対、オルガン、絶対、弾く課題、絶対、出たよね、お前、覚えてる?本気で
lines.en: Riku, remember that organ assignment from music class? We actually had to play it. You remember that, right?
lines.style: Quick, urgent energy. Leans forward on the opening name. Rapid-fire delivery, testing his attention. Slightly exasperated affection—checking if he was actually paying attention back then.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: うん。お祖母ちゃん、本気で、絶対、学童保育、絶対、ボランティアで、絶対、頑張ってるんだぜ、桜
lines.en: Yeah. Your grandma's actually volunteering at the daycare, Sakura. She's really giving it her all.
lines.style: Warm admiration in the tone. Slower than Sakura's rush—giving the sentence room to land. Genuine respect for the effort. Slight lift at the end, like he's proud to mention it.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 修学旅行で、本気で、絶対、お寺の祭壇、絶対、見てきたよ、リク
lines.en: We went to see that temple altar on the school trip. I'm telling you, Riku, it was something.
lines.style: Quieter, more reflective. Eyes slightly distant—remembering the moment. Slower pace, letting the image breathe. Soft conviction that he'll understand why she's bringing it up.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 夏休み、本気で、絶対、観覧車、絶対、お前と、絶対、乗ろうな、桜、本気で、絶対、約束
lines.en: This summer—I want to ride the Ferris wheel with you, Sakura. Let's promise we'll go.
lines.style: Direct and earnest. No hedging. Steady eye contact in the voice. The slight vulnerability of saying what he wants. Warm but unguarded—this matters to him.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 生物部で、本気で、絶対、顕微鏡、絶対、よく、絶対、使ってるよ、リク、本気で、絶対、面白い
lines.en: I use the microscope all the time in the bio club. It's actually really interesting what you can see.
lines.style: Animated, discovering as she speaks. Light energy—shares the genuine excitement of looking closely at things. Quick pace. Natural enthusiasm, not performed.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 映画の、本気で、絶対、プレビュー、絶対、見たいよな、桜、お互いに、絶対、約束しような
lines.en: I want to catch that film preview with you, Sakura. Let's promise we'll do it together.
lines.style: Eager but grounded. Reaches for her with the idea, not demanding. Soft invitation in the tone. The 'together' lands gently—he's asking for something shared.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: ガーナ産の、本気で、絶対、チョコ、絶対、お父さんのお土産で、絶対、もらったわよ、リク、本気で、絶対、嬉しかった
lines.en: Dad brought back this chocolate from Ghana. I got some as a souvenir, Riku—it really made my day.
lines.style: Bright, almost surprised by her own happiness. Light, warm delivery. Quick energy on the opening. The 'it really made my day' is genuine, unguarded—shows him what small things mean to her.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 文化祭、本気で、絶対、出店の売れ行き、絶対、好調らしいぜ、桜、お互いに、絶対、頑張ろうな
lines.en: The culture festival booth is selling like crazy, Sakura. Let's both keep pushing—we've got this.
lines.style: Confident and encouraging. Steady voice with building momentum. The 'we've got this' is a quiet affirmation, not a shout. Shoulder-to-shoulder tone—they're in it together.
